text:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO 5m p99 spike detected for /generate (streaming). Region: eu-west-1. Current p99: 2.4s (SLO 1.0s). Increasing error budget burn. Paging oncall.

oncall-eric: I'm on it. Seeing a big tail in the router metrics, +350ms p99 delta starting ~2480123300. Any recent deploys? :eyes: 

sre-erin: No infra deploys in eu-west-1 in the last hour. Routing policy did roll at 2480119800 (policy v3.4.1 -> v3.4.2) — that changed affinity TTL handling.

eng-runtime: Confirmed. The v3.4.2 rollout tweaked sticky routing to prefer sticky affinity even across shard rebalances. Could amplify hot partitions.

oncall-eric: That matches. Streaming stalls show long queue times in router proxies, and some backends showing high CPU pinned to processes handling those affinities.

alice: Logs showing a small set of session keys with huge QPS. Example: session_id=abc123 repeated on same backend. Stack traces show streaming stall at kvcache fetch.

bob: Quick check: running `curl -s http://router-metrics/eu-west-1/p99?range=10m` returned chunky p99 around 2.2s. Will dump top keys by hash: `topkeys --region=eu-west-1 --window=10m | head -n 20`

carla: Copy of router config diff from the rollout: ```diff
- affinity_ttl: 300
+ affinity_ttl: 3600
+ enforce_strong_affinity: true
```

eng-runtime: That's the change. Setting TTL from 5m -> 60m and enforcing strong affinity. On paper reduces cross-traffic, but if a key becomes hot it pins to the same shard and overloads it.

oncall-eric: Customer-impact check: CS indicates 3 paid customers in EU have seen degraded streaming latencies and one reported timeouts for long-running streams. No 5xxs observed yet, mostly stalls and client retries.

customer-success: Customer A (SaaS-Health) reported user-facing spinner for ~10s, opened ticket INC-5432. They asked if there's an ETA.

incident-bot: On-call handoff reminder: @sre-erin is second responder, escalate if mitigation incomplete in 15m.

sre-erin: Action plan: 1) disable enforce_strong_affinity (hotfix) 2) shorten affinity_ttl to 60s 3) drain the top overloaded backend(s) 4) monitor p95/p99 and streaming stall counts. I'll execute 1+2 as a config override to the active policy.

eng-runtime: +1 to rollback strong affinity. Patch snippet to push as override: ```yaml
policy_override:
  enforce_strong_affinity: false
  affinity_ttl: 60
```

oncall-eric: I'm going to apply override to eu-west-1 via `rctl policy apply --region eu-west-1 --file override.yaml` now. Will watch metrics.

oncall-eric: ⚙️ applied override at 2480123590. Rolling window update should hit routers within ~20s.

bob: Started draining two heavy nodes: router-backend-eu-7 and -eu-9. `drain --node router-backend-eu-7 --grace=30s`

carla: Added temporary rate-limiter on session keys exceeding 250 RPS: `rlimit session_key:250` to smooth bursts.

eng-runtime: Observability note — KV cache hit rate spike is expected as traffic rebalances. Watch KV eviction thrash.

oncall-eric: p99 dropped to 1.1s at 2480123715 (after override). p95 back under 400ms. Streaming stall counts down 80% vs peak. 

sre-erin: Good. Continue drains until load evenly distributed. I'll keep enforce_strong_affinity off until we have a safe rollout plan.

customer-success: Told Customer A we rolled a mitigation and will monitor for 30m before full postmortem. They acknowledged. :thumbsup: 

eng-runtime: Root cause hypothesis: affinity TTL and strong-affinity flag caused sticky assignments to persist across rebalancing window, creating hot partitions when a high-QPS session targeted a single shard. Combined with our greedy routing policy that didn't split large sessions, this produced queueing and streaming stalls.

carla: Notes for follow-up: add telemetry for per-session QPS spikes, alert on session-key hot thresholds, and make affinity TTL rollouts gated behind a canary that checks per-key load.

oncall-eric: I'll keep the channel updated. Next steps: 1) Continue drains for 20m 2) Run canary of affinity_ttl change on 1% traffic with hotkey protections 3) Postmortem to be created and assigned to eng-runtime + sre within 48h.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident severity classified as Sev2. Incident window start: 2480123300. Current mitigation state: partial-mitigated.

sre-erin: I'm taking ownership of the postmortem. Assigning to @eng-runtime and @carla for remediation tasks. Will include a timeline, triggers, and a rollback playbook.

oncall-eric: Final check: p99 stable ~0.95s at 2480124030, streaming stall events at baseline. Closing live mitigation; will keep an eye for 30m then mark as resolved if stable.

pager-duty: Acknowledged. Handing back to normal ops.

carla: Quick TODOs added to tracker: HOTKEY_ALERTS-12, AFFINITY_CANARY-7, ROUTER_POLICY_DOCS-21.

customer-success: Updated Customer A with mitigation complete and follow-up postmortem ETA. They asked for proactive notice on future routing changes.

incident-bot: Incident closed for live mitigation at 2480124056. Please continue asynchronous follow-ups in #postmortems and assign owner tags.
